title: Terms and Conditions
html:
Privacy Policy

Effective Date: 1/12/2024

At Videmak.net, your privacy is of paramount importance to us. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal information when you visit our website or use our services. By using Videmak.net, you consent to the collection and use of your information as described in this policy.

1. Information We Collect

We collect the following types of information:

a. Personal Information
When you register or use our services, we may collect personal information such as:

  • Name
  • Email address
  • Phone number
  • Payment information (if applicable)

b. Non-Personal Information
We may collect non-personal information that does not identify you specifically, such as:

  • Browser type and version
  • Device type
  • IP address
  • Pages visited on our website
  • Time spent on the website
  • Referring website addresses

c. Cookies and Tracking Technologies
We use cookies and similar technologies to enhance your user experience and track website usage. Cookies are small files placed on your device that help us remember your preferences and improve our services. You can disable cookies in your browser settings, but this may affect some features of our website.

2. How We Use Your Information

We use the information we collect for the following purposes:

  • To provide, maintain, and improve our services.
  • To process transactions and payments (if applicable).
  • To communicate with you, respond to inquiries, and send updates about our services.
  • To analyze website usage and optimize user experience.
  • To prevent fraud, monitor security, and comply with legal obligations.

3. Data Sharing and Disclosure

We will not share, sell, or rent your personal information to third parties without your consent, except in the following circumstances:

  • Service Providers: We may share your information with trusted third-party service providers who assist us in operating our website, conducting our business, or providing services to you. These providers are obligated to keep your information confidential.
  • Legal Compliance: We may disclose your information if required to do so by law or in response to a legal request, such as a subpoena or court order.
  • Business Transfers: In the event of a merger, acquisition, or sale of assets, your personal information may be transferred as part of that transaction.

4. Data Security

We take reasonable measures to protect your personal information from unauthorized access, alteration, or destruction. However, no method of transmission over the internet or electronic storage is completely secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

5. Your Rights and Choices

You have the right to:

  • Access: Request a copy of the personal information we hold about you.
  • Correction: Correct any inaccurate or incomplete information.
  • Deletion: Request the deletion of your personal information, subject to legal obligations.
  • Opt-Out: Opt out of receiving marketing communications from us by following the unsubscribe instructions in emails or contacting us directly.

To exercise your rights, please contact us using the details provided below.

6. Third-Party Websites

Our website may contain links to third-party websites that are not under our control. We are not responsible for the privacy practices or content of these sites. We encourage you to read the privacy policies of any third-party websites you visit.

7. Children's Privacy

Videmak.net does not knowingly collect or solicit personal information from individuals under the age of 13. If we learn that we have collected personal information from a child under 13, we will take steps to delete such information.

8. International Transfers

If you are accessing Videmak.net from outside of [Your Country], please be aware that your personal information may be transferred to and stored in servers located in USA. By using our website, you consent to the transfer of your information to USA.

9. Changes to This Privacy Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. When we make changes, we will update the "Effective Date" at the top of this page. We encourage you to review this policy periodically for any updates.

10. Contact Us

If you have any questions or concerns about this Privacy Policy or how we handle your personal information, please contact us at:

Email: info@videmak.org
Phone: +18483152248
Address: 1111B S Governors Ave STE 26609 Dover, DE, 19904 US

By using Videmak.net, you consent to the practices described in this Privacy Policy. Thank you for trusting us with your information!

title: Data Deletion Policy
html:
Videmak Research AI — Facebook App Data Deletion Policy

Effective Date: 01/01/2025

1. Scope

This Data Deletion Policy applies when you, as a user, link or authorize our Facebook App (via Facebook Login or other Facebook SDK features) and we gain access to your Facebook data (profile info, friends list, email, etc.). It describes how you may request deletion of your Facebook‐connected data, how we respond, and how we notify Facebook that the data has been deleted.

2. What data is covered

When you use Facebook to log in or connect with Videmak Research AI, we may store:

  • Your Facebook profile information (name, email, profile picture)
  • Your Facebook user ID associated with our app
  • Any other permissions you granted via Facebook (for instance, if you grant access to your friends list or other data)
  • Any data we generate or store in connection with your Facebook access (such as internal identifiers, tokens, logs)
    This policy covers the deletion of the above data when you choose to disconnect the Facebook integration or request deletion.

3. How you can request deletion

You may request deletion of your Facebook‐connected data from Videmak by doing one of the following:

  • Logging into your Videmak account → navigating to Account Settings → Connected Apps → Disconnect Facebook.
  • Contacting our support at [insert email address] with subject “Facebook App Data Deletion Request”. Please include your Videmak account email and indicate you want all Facebook‐connected data removed.
  • If you delete your Videmak account entirely, that includes the deletion of Facebook‐connected data (see also our general Account Deletion/Retention Policy).

4. What happens when you request deletion

Upon receipt of your deletion request:

  • We will delete or anonymise all stored Facebook‐linked personal data (as listed in Section 2) from our active systems within 30 days.
  • We will invalidate any access tokens or credentials obtained via Facebook for your account.
  • We will remove stored logs or metadata that tie your Videmak account to your Facebook identity (unless required to keep them for legal compliance).
  • After deletion, we will send you confirmation via email that your Facebook‐connected data has been removed.

5. Notification to Facebook

In compliance with Facebook’s Platform Policies, we will notify Facebook (via the App Dashboard or API as required) that we have deleted the user’s data associated with the Facebook App. This ensures our app remains compliant and that Facebook can update its records.

6. Exception & retention policy

  • If you have other linked services (not Facebook) or have stored content/data independent of Facebook login, those are subject to our broader Data Retention & Deletion Policy (see our Privacy Policy).
  • We may retain aggregated or anonymised data that cannot be attributed to an individual user for analytical or legal compliance purposes.
  • If there are legal obligations (e.g., tax laws, litigation holds) or legitimate business reasons to retain certain records, we may postpone deletion for that subset. We will inform you during the deletion confirmation if any data is retained under legal or regulatory exception, and will specify the retention period.

7. What if you only unlink Facebook but keep your Videmak account

If you disconnect Facebook integration but remain a Videmak user:

  • We will remove the Facebook user ID and associated permissions from our systems.
  • You may still continue to use Videmak normally (via email/password or other login).
  • You must provide an alternative login method if your account currently relies solely on Facebook login.
  • We will treat your future activities under the alternative login method without linking to your former Facebook data.

8. Data security & verification

  • To prevent unauthorized deletion requests, we will verify that the request originates from the account holder (e.g., via the registered email, login session).
  • We maintain appropriate technical and organisational measures to safeguard your personal data until such time as deletion is effected.

9. Changes to this policy

We may update this Data Deletion Policy from time to time. We will post a new version on our website and notify users where required by law. The “Effective Date” at the top will reflect when changes take effect.

10. Contact information

If you have any questions or concerns regarding this policy or our handling of your Facebook‐connected data, please contact us at:
Email: admin@videmak.org
Address: 1111B S Governors Ave STE 26609 Dover, DE, 19904 US
Website: https://videmak.net

 

Suggestions for next steps

  • Insert your actual support email, business address, and contact details.
  • Ensure that your Privacy Policy references this Facebook App Data Deletion Policy clearly.
  • Confirm that your Facebook App settings (in Facebook Developer Dashboard) list a valid “Data Deletion Callback URL” and retention timeframe that matches or is shorter than your policy.
  • Review the timeframes: Facebook requires that you handle deletion requests “immediately” or within a maximum of 90 days (check the current Platform Policy). It’s good you commit to 30 days or less.
  • Document internally how deletion requests are tracked, verified, and logged.
